capabilities: Preserve fold states when copying and pasting folded sections, including across notes
Toggle fold state for all headings, list items, code blocks, and callouts in a selection
Keep folds intact when indenting or outdenting with Tab and Shift-Tab
Bind the selection fold-toggle command to a custom hotkey
disambiguation: Not an outline view or note structure editor; it only preserves and toggles the fold state of existing headings, lists, code blocks, and callouts.
extras: README documents a known limitation: multi-cursor copies do not preserve fold state.
problem: Obsidian unfolds headings when you paste text or re-indent, so folded sections in long notes lose their state.
summary: Fold-state manager that keeps headings folded through copy/paste and re-indenting, and adds bulk fold toggling for selections.
